title: WINDOW GUIDE CAM & GLASS OPERATING EFFORT
summary: Door window guide cams (all models): the front and rear cam assemblies are the vertical channels inside the door that guide the glass rollers. Each cam is screwed at its top to the door upper frame (front one with a plate) and at its bottom to the door inner panel; a stop is screwed to the lower end of the rear cam and another to the front cam top. The cam tracks are greased (1g). Also gives the maximum window crank effort.

notes: SIDE DOOR GLASS OPERATING EFFORT: The side door window operating effort with the door in the closed position is not to exceed 25 inch lbs maximum at the regulator shaft when operating the window down or up to within 1-1/2" of the top of the travel. The effort is not to exceed 50 inch lbs when operating window down or up during the last 1-1/2" of the top of the travel.
